method.render_usec: Time from RenderingServer frame_pre_draw to frame_post_draw; automatic rendering retained and normal frame advance checked. Not whole-game frame time.

method.graphics_freeze: Clone each shader with TIME replaced by 1.25; retain originals and swap back after the fixture. Do not hot-rewrite already compiled Forward+ shaders in this test.

limitations: No production occlusion switch or occluder lifecycle was added. This is a diagnostic only.

Frozen maps omit gameplay actors, controls, interactions and camera fading. Soft-ground deformation, ground-contact blending, HD upscaling and volumetric effects are disabled in both controls. Grass and directional shadows are explicit optional conditions.

Terrain uses exact authored tile triangles (32768 triangles per sampled map), not coarse simplified geometry. Opaque-object mode conservatively rejects every texture with any alpha in any mip and admits only the known static OBJECT_SHADER. Neither policy is a complete production eligibility policy.
Seven fortress views/configurations still differ by 1-18 pixels over 2/255, maximum 27/255. These differences have not been attributed; do not transfer the earlier P3 nine-pixel result to them.

Camera poses are compared after settling, including the first frame after enabling culling. Continuous camera motion, thin openings, cave entrances, scripted movers, fading and deformed terrain remain untested for this proposal.

Native viewport CPU cost rises in all 18 terrain-only Compatibility baseline views. Pre/post draw wall time is mixed and native GPU timing varies between runs. Draw savings do not establish a general frame-rate improvement.
No other recognized game/editor renderer was found at each run start/end. This is not continuous machine-load isolation; CPU/GPU clock and unrelated background load were not fixed.

The raw shadow_draws counter is zero even in the shadow-enabled fixtures. It is not evidence of no shadows or equal caster workload; visible draw counts may include auxiliary/shadow passes. Image comparisons are the only rendered-equivalence evidence here.
Standard web builds disable module_raycast by default in the pinned engine source. The actual browser build and physical Android performance were not tested; Retroid remained with the other chat.
build_usec measures script-side resource assembly, including alpha readbacks for opaque-object mode. It excludes asynchronous native BVH construction and is not a zone-load measurement.
